program.name: Lift Sweat Stretch
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: Heavy straight sets, a hard conditioning finisher and a real stretch of the muscles you trained.
program.about: The order the name says: lift heavy in straight sets, sweat through a hard block, then stretch what you worked. Leg days finish with an AMRAP and a stretch for hips and hamstrings, upper days with a ladder and a stretch for chest, shoulders and back, and full-body days with a circuit and a stretch from feet to neck. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps, the conditioning adds reps, and every stretch is held a bit longer.
program.split: Legs / upper / full body: heavy sets, a hard finisher and a long stretch
program.gear: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell, a sturdy chair or couch, and a pull-up bar on upper days.
